mapper.select: SELECT producer_id AS producerId, user_no AS userNo, biz_no AS bizNo, biz_name AS bizName, biz_addr AS bizAddr, biz_phone AS bizPhone, bank_name AS bankName, bank_account_no AS bankAccountNo, account_holder AS accountHolder, is_verified AS isVerified, verified_at AS verifiedAt, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM PRODUCER WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE is_verified = 'N' ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'Y', verified_at = SYSDATE, reject_reason = NULL, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, -- 상품명 컬럼 이름: name d.stock_qty AS stockQty, -- 실제 재고 10 AS safetyStockQty -- 임시 안전 재고 기준 (예: 10개) FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCT_DETAIL d ON d.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} AND d.stock_qty < 10 ORDER BY d.stock_qty ASC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, d.carrier_name AS carrierName, d.tracking_number AS trackingNumber,
o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.receiver_addr AS receiverAddr,
NVL(p_item.product_id, p_gd.product_id) AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount,
oi.group_deal_id AS groupDealId, gd.title AS groupDealTitle, gd.deal_price AS groupDealPrice, gd.shipping_start_date AS groupDealShippingStartDate, gd.shipping_end_date AS groupDealShippingEndDate
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_item ON oi.product_id = p_item.product_id LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL gd ON oi.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_gd ON gd.product_id = p_gd.product_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND ( (oi.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_item.producer_id = #{producerId}) OR (oi.group_deal_id IS NOT NULL AND gd.created_by = #{loginUserId}) ) ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
mapper.update:
BEGIN UPDATE DELIVERY d SET d.delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, d.updated_date = SYSDATE, d.shipped_at = CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus} IN ('출고완료', '배송중', '배송완료') AND d.shipped_at IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE d.shipped_at END, d.delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus} = '배송완료' AND d.delivered_at IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE d.delivered_at END WHERE d.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_item ON oi.product_id = p_item.product_id -- 일반 주문 LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL gd ON oi.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id -- 공동구매 LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_gd ON gd.product_id = p_gd.product_id -- 공동구매 연결 상품 WHERE oi.order_item_id = d.order_item_id AND ( -- 일반 상품: PRODUCER_ID 로 체크 (oi.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_item.producer_id = #{producerId}) OR -- 공동구매: CREATED_BY(아이디) 로 체크 (oi.group_deal_id IS NOT NULL AND gd.created_by = #{loginUserId}) ) );
UPDATE ORDERS_ITEM oi SET oi.order_status = CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus} = '배송완료' THEN 'A2' ELSE 'A1' END WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi2 LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_item ON oi2.product_id = p_item.product_id LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL gd ON oi2.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_gd ON gd.product_id = p_gd.product_id WHERE oi2.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id AND ( (oi2.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_item.producer_id = #{producerId}) OR (oi2.group_deal_id IS NOT NULL AND gd.created_by = #{loginUserId}) ) ); END;
mapper.select:
SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.receiver_addr AS receiverAddr,
NVL(p_item.product_id, p_gd.product_id) AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount,
oi.group_deal_id AS groupDealId, gd.title AS groupDealTitle, gd.deal_price AS groupDealPrice, gd.shipping_start_date AS groupDealShippingStartDate, gd.shipping_end_date AS groupDealShippingEndDate
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_item ON oi.product_id = p_item.product_id -- 일반 상품 LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL gd ON oi.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id -- 공동구매 LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_gd ON gd.product_id = p_gd.product_id -- 필요하면 상품 정보
JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE ( -- 일반 상품: PRODUCT.PRODUCER_ID 기준 (oi.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_item.producer_id = #{producerId}) OR -- 공동구매: GROUP_DEAL.CREATED_BY 기준 (아이디명) (oi.group_deal_id IS NOT NULL AND gd.created_by = #{loginUserId}) ) AND oi.order_status IN ('A1') ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.receiver_addr AS receiverAddr, p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND oi.order_status IN ('A2', 'R1', 'E1', 'E2', 'E3') ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT TRUNC(o.order_date) AS salesDate, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY TRUNC(o.order_date) ORDER BY salesDate

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.receiver_addr AS receiverAddr, p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND oi.order_status IN ('A2', 'E1', 'E2', 'E3') ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT t.productId, t.productName, t.totalQuantity, t.totalAmount FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND oi.order_status IN ('A2', 'E1', 'E2', 'E3') GROUP BY p.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_DETAIL pd SET pd.unit_name = #{unitName}, pd.price = #{price}, pd.stock_qty = #{stockQty}, pd.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE pd.detail_id = #{detailId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.product_id = pd.product_id AND p.producer_id = #{producerId} )

UPDATE DELIVERY d SET d.carrier_name = #{carrierName}, d.tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, d.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE d.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_item ON oi.product_id = p_item.product_id LEFT JOIN GROUP_DEAL gd ON oi.group_deal_id = gd.group_deal_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p_gd ON gd.product_id = p_gd.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id = d.order_item_id AND ( p_item.producer_id = #{producerId} OR p_gd.producer_id = #{producerId} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, oi.order_status AS orderStatus, d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.receiver_addr AS receiverAddr, p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND oi.order_status IN ('B1', 'R1') ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_id AS orderNo, o.receiver_name AS buyerName, MIN(oi.product_name) AS firstProductName, COUNT(*) AS itemCount, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount, MIN(oi.order_status) AS status, TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS orderDate FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND oi.order_status IN ('B1', 'R1') -- 🔥 환불 관련 상태만 GROUP BY o.order_id, o.receiver_name, o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
SELECT PRODUCT_DETAIL_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
SELECT PRODUCT_IMAGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( product_id, producer_id, name, base_category_id, main_image, summary, status, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{producerId}, #{productName}, #{baseCategoryId}, #{mainImage}, #{summary}, -- ★ 기존 NULL → 파라미터로 저장 NVL(#{status}, '판매중'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO PRODUCT_DETAIL ( detail_id, product_id, grade, unit_name, price, stock_qty, origin_region, harvest_date, expire_date, detail_desc, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{detailId}, #{productId}, #{grade}, #{unitName}, #{price}, #{stockQty}, #{origin}, -- ★ 원산지 CASE WHEN #{harvestDate} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(#{harvestDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{expireDate} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(#{expireDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE NULL END, #{detailDesc}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGE ( image_id, product_id, image_url, is_main, sort_order, created_date ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{productId}, #{imageUrl}, #{isMain}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, pd.detail_id AS detailId, p.name AS productName, p.base_category_id AS baseCategoryId, -- 그대로 pd.grade AS grade, -- ★ 추가 pd.unit_name AS unitName, pd.price AS price, pd.stock_qty AS stockQty, p.status AS status, pd.updated_date AS updatedDate FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCT_DETAIL pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} AND p.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY pd.detail_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT p SET p.name = #{productName}, p.base_category_id = #{baseCategoryId}, p.status = NVL(#{status}, p.status), p.main_image = NVL(#{mainImage}, p.main_image), p.summary = NVL(#{summary}, p.summary), p.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.producer_id = #{producerId}

UPDATE PRODUCT_DETAIL pd SET pd.grade = #{grade}, pd.unit_name = #{unitName}, pd.price = #{price}, pd.stock_qty = #{stockQty}, pd.origin_region = NVL(#{origin}, pd.origin_region), pd.harvest_date = CASE WHEN #{harvestDate} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(#{harvestDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE pd.harvest_date END, pd.expire_date = CASE WHEN #{expireDate} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(#{expireDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE pd.expire_date END, pd.detail_desc = NVL(#{detailDesc}, pd.detail_desc), pd.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.product_id = pd.product_id AND p.producer_id = #{producerId} )

BEGIN -- 1) USERS 기본 정보 수정 UPDATE USERS u SET u.name = #{name}, u.phone = #{phone}, u.addr = #{addr}, u.email = #{email}, u.photo = #{photo}, u.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE u.user_no = ( SELECT p.user_no FROM PRODUCER p WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} );
-- 2) PRODUCER 사업장/정산 정보 수정 UPDATE PRODUCER p SET p.biz_name = #{bizName}, p.biz_addr = #{bizAddr}, p.biz_phone = #{bizPhone}, p.bank_name = #{bankName}, p.bank_account_no = #{bankAccountNo}, p.account_holder = #{accountHolder}, p.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId}; END;

u.role = 'PRODUCER_PENDING'
u.role = 'PRODUCER'
u.role = 'USER' AND p.reject_reason IS NOT NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET role = 'PRODUCER', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = ( SELECT user_no FROM PRODUCER WHERE producer_id = #{producerId} )
UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'Y', verified_at = SYSDATE, reject_reason = NULL, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
UPDATE USERS SET role = 'USER', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = ( SELECT user_no FROM PRODUCER WHERE producer_id = #{producerId} )
UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'N', verified_at = NULL, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, u.user_no AS userNo, o.order_total_amount AS payAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN USERS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id -- 🔥 여기 수정! WHERE oi.order_item_id = #{orderItemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN DELIVERY d ON oi.order_item_id = d.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.delivery_status <> '배송완료'
